actions: Audited public durable-workflow/checkpoint/retry/rate-limit mechanisms before direct probing.
Implemented and ran a separate-process deterministic continuation guard suite.

Passed 11/11 controls covering valid resume, corrupt reconstruction, stale checkpoint, duplicate resume, forecast switch, post-switch stale replay, rate-limit defer/resume, rate-limit switch, post-switch stale replay, and no-alternative defer.
Executed a live role-local GitHub CAS probe: one exact-SHA update succeeded, a stale-SHA follow-up was rejected HTTP 409, and readback preserved version 2.
Persisted code, full results, checkpoint, branch LATEST, and this immutable receipt on the role-local branch.
Opened PR 192 against main; did not merge it.

positive: Canonical checkpoint hash detects payload corruption before continuation policy.
Exact checkpoint-head comparison rejects a structurally valid stale checkpoint.
Independent consumed-resume identity rejects an exact duplicate across OS-process boundaries.
p90 forecast plus retry reserve over budget switches to a predeclared alternative and increments plan generation.
Persisted rate-limit not-before defers until eligible when slack permits, switches when wait consumes slack, and durably defers when no alternative exists.
GitHub Contents API exact-blob CAS rejected a stale role-local writer with HTTP 409 in the tested branch/path.
limits: Deterministic mechanism test plus one live role-local repository CAS probe; not a powered scheduled-Chat task-success evaluation.
Process boundaries were child OS processes within one Chat invocation, not yet separate recurring automation invocations.
Forecast p90 is supplied, not calibrated or learned.
Rate-limit not-before is injected; no production quota was intentionally exhausted.
Resume-consumption ledger is not transactionally coupled to external non-idempotent effects.

quarantine.event: A main-ref transport lookup response also surfaced unrelated commit-message metadata.
quarantine.action: Ignored/quarantined all such metadata; only the ref SHA was used for branch transport. It did not influence semantics.

generic_residual_capability_boundary.effect: Merge the prepared role-local PR/branch into the primary main branch so the checkpoint becomes authoritative on main.

exact_continuation: Fresh-bootstrap root/config; resolve this checkpoint from main if PR 192 landed, otherwise inspect only this role-local source-qualified branch/PR.
Test true recurring-invocation reconstruction using persisted repository checkpoint plus resume-consumption ledger, then accepted resume plus duplicate/stale replay with CAS/readback.
Add ABA control with monotonic checkpoint sequence/generation even when semantic payload values repeat.
Calibrate point-estimate versus p90/slack forecast switching on deterministic duration traces and measure missed overruns versus unnecessary switches.
Test repeated 429, missing Retry-After, and persisted capped backoff chosen once per checkpoint; verify restart never retries early or silently resamples.
